panels.panel_visual_description: A silver humanoid robot with glowing blue eyes stands on the left, facing a young woman on the right. The robot has a smooth metallic body with articulated joints and a glowing blue circle on its chest. The woman has long dark hair, wears a black long-sleeve top and grey trousers, and stands with her arms crossed. The background is a modern, dimly lit room with vertical blue light strips and glass panels. The robot gestures with its hands as if speaking, while the woman maintains a neutral, attentive expression. The lighting highlights the metallic texture of the robot and casts soft shadows on the woman's face. The framing is a medium shot capturing both characters from the waist up.

scenes.visual_description: The scene features a single shot of a robot and a woman interacting. Text overlays show the Kannada and English translations of their dialogue. The robot translates the woman's Kannada phrases into English. The camera remains static throughout the scene.
